title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million for running 62 natural gas generators without required permits at a data center under construction in Vineland. State inspectors found the tractor trailer size, 2,000 kilowatt generators during a late July visit. The state said the fine was for violating the Air Pollution Control Act and was the largest ever issued to a New Jersey data center operator. The planned campus is described as one of the largest on the Eastern Seaboard.

The Vineland campus is set to be completed at the end of the year. It will cover 2.6 million square feet and need 350 megawatts of power, enough for a medium size city. Some of it is already in use. The project has drawn complaints, including a federal lawsuit from homeowners over persistent noise and violation orders from the Cumberland County Health Department for excessive noise.
